company.name: Postscript
company.shortDescription: Postscript is an SMS platform that enables brands to communicate and engage with customers through text message marketing.
company.description: Postscript is an eCommerce SMS platform that enables brands to communicate and engage with customers through text message marketing. It allows users to easily create and manage SMS marketing campaigns with detailed analytics to improve sales and revenue. It plugs into eCommerce businesses and helps overcome declining email engagement by sending customers targeted and customizable SMS marketing.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $65,000,000, or 61.21% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,863,879 to $531,619,508, a 67.6x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
